articles.title: This Tiny Robot Just Did 10 Backflips in 11 Seconds!
articles.summary: MIT scientists made a robot bug the size of a microcassette that can flip through the air faster than ever. It uses AI to stay steady, even when wind tries to knock it off course.

articles.title: 5 Ways the Dinosaur World Was Nothing Like Ours
articles.summary: No grass, no polar ice, and a giant supercontinent! The world of dinosaurs was totally different from Earth today—and not just because of the dinosaurs.

articles.title: Fossil Poop and Footprints: The Clues Dinosaurs Left Behind
articles.summary: Trace fossils are footprints, burrows, and even poop that tell us how ancient animals lived. They're like a detective story written in rock!
